newsitem.title: CHINA: China in $685 mln purchase of 5 Boeing jets.
newsitem.headline: China in $685 mln purchase of 5 Boeing jets.

text.p: The Civil Aviation General Administration of China (CAAC) and Boeing Co have agreed a $685 million deal on Tuesday for Air China to purchase five Boeing 777-200 airliners, White House officials said.

Under the agreement, the administration will order the five new-generation Boeing 777-200 aircraft for Chinese international carrier Air China. Three of the planes will be delivered by the end of 1998 and the other two in 1999, officials said.

The agreement is to be signed by Ronald Woodard president of Boeing Commercial Airplane Group, and Shen Yuankang, deputy director of the administration, and witnessed by visiting U.S. Vice President Al Gore.
